policy.invariant: A policy has one pending revision or retirement; approved versions form immutable successor intervals; activation requires the latest accepted independent review and independent approval; approved or retired content cannot be edited.
policy.implementation: Policy owns a tenant/policy stream and its revision, review, approval, retirement lifecycle. Existing tests cover independent review/approval, effective successor, retirement, stale edits and exact retry.

artifact_download_grant.invariant: One exact receiving grant owns the authenticated encrypted original artifact ticket/result after EvidenceArtifact admits and pins availability; it binds tenant, artifact, command and original actor; expiry does not renew under the same root, and cancellation fences delayed issuance.
artifact_download_grant.implementation: Aggregate status reports no exact ArtifactDownloadGrant type declaration. Existing download behavior is handled by EvidenceArtifact and IssueArtifactDownloadHandler; the choreography defines a separate receiving identity and issued-v2/canceled lifecycle.

evidence_artifact.invariant: An artifact is immutable registered content, unavailable before clean inspection; malware quarantine can be released only after an attributed clean rescan; secret/invalid rejection is final. Download grant issuance has its own receiving identity.
evidence_artifact.implementation: EvidenceArtifact owns registration, inspection, quarantine release and legacy artifact download facts. Tests cover registration, inspection, quarantine release boundaries and issuance handler.

policy_lifecycle.instructions: Do the stated immutable-version, independent-review/approval, and retirement rules justify Policy as one business aggregate with its own lifecycle?

criteria.true: One policy version line owns these linked transitions and prevents editing approved or retired content.
criteria.false: The transitions have independent authority and do not require a shared policy lifecycle.

download_grant_boundary.instructions: Do the stated receiving-ticket, exact actor/artifact/command binding, expiry, and cancellation-fence rules require an ArtifactDownloadGrant owner separate from EvidenceArtifact content and inspection?

criteria.true: The receiving grant has its own identity and terminal lifecycle, separate from the artifact content and inspection state.
criteria.false: The grant has no independent receiving identity or lifecycle and is fully owned by the artifact record.

evidence_artifact_boundary.instructions: Does immutable content registration with inspection and quarantine-release lifecycle justify EvidenceArtifact as a distinct owner from the per-download receiving grant?

criteria.true: Content identity and inspection lifecycle are independent from issuance of a particular download ticket.
criteria.false: Artifact content and each individual receiving ticket must be decided atomically by one owner.
